summary: Client UI: per-player state of gui::tooltips::WorldTooltipsSystem (world tooltips of items/characters). The system adds it to a player's user entity, keeps there the entity the tooltips are computed for, and a set of item entities whose item view-model did not exist yet. Never seen alive.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x12EC340 (AllocRaw 0x38) writes 0xFFC0000000000000 (null handle). Toolkit NoesisGameUI.dll+0x3D0480 (WorldTooltipsSystem::Update) adds the component to the entity resolved from a playerId (FUN_18017FFB0) and writes the 8-byte entity of the player record into +0 (line ~486); later it checks +0 as a valid handle and builds the tooltip WorldView / TryGet for it (lines ~621, ~810). Toolkit copy constructor NoesisGameUI.dll+0x30ABC0 copies +0 as 8 bytes.

fields.name: PendingItems
fields.evidence: Toolkit move constructor NoesisGameUI.dll+0x30AB40 moves ptr/u32/u32 triples at +8, +0x18, +0x28 (HashSet buckets, NextIds, Keys); destructor NoesisGameUI.dll+0x30B6D0 frees +0x28 with an IndexedStorage<ls::ID<ecs::EntityHandleTraits>> (assert in NoesisGameUI.dll+0x316020), +0x18 with IndexedStorage<int> and +8. Update inserts (FUN_1800F88D0(this+8, ...), line ~1030) item entities for which VMItemDataSingletonComponent::LEGACY_GetItemObject returns null, and empties the set first (buckets memset -1, key count +0x34). bg3.exe creator zeroes +8..+0x38 and registers destructor bg3.exe+0x6B4CB0. Name inferred from that use.
